entries.zh: 顺流；顺水而下（随水流漂下、顺流而行）
entries.en: to go with the current; to float/run downstream

entries.zh: 跑掉；不答而去（跑开不应声）
entries.en: to run off without answering; to run away and not reply
entries.notes: 首字带重文号存疑同上条；据西栏“跑了不应答”与尾字“去”定释义。

entries.zh: 走马楼；环屋而建的回廊、骑楼（可通行的檐廊走道）
entries.en: veranda; covered gallery or porch running round a house

entries.zh: 行家；内行、精通本业之人（亦指大买卖的居间行商、中人）
entries.en: expert, one versed in a trade; broker for larger transactions

entries.en: running messenger; one who hurries about delivering news

entries.zh: 铺兵；铺递中徒步递送公文之兵卒（官府急递铺差役）
entries.en: foot courier of the postal relay; soldier carrying dispatches on foot

entries.en: express dispatch by post; swift news, victory report

entries.zh: 钦差；钦命差遣的使臣（皇帝所遣的差官、专使）
entries.en: imperial commissioner; envoy dispatched by sovereign order

entries.zh: 承差；承办公差的差役（官府传递公文之人）
entries.en: official courier; yamen runner undertaking official errands

entries.en: tender, soft; delicate

entries.en: to come to one's aid; to reinforce, receive and support
